data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Wart & antiviral agents_

**Class:** Aldehyde antiseptics/fixatives — formaldehyde (formalin 3–10% soaks) and glutaraldehyde (10–20%)

## Mechanism of action
- Cross-link proteins → kill virus-infected keratinocytes and dry the skin (anhidrotic and antiviral effects)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Plantar and mosaic warts (soaks/paints)
- Plantar hyperhidrosis and bromhidrosis (soaks)
- Instrument disinfection (glutaraldehyde 2%)

## Dose & formulations
- Formalin 3–5% foot soak for 10–15 min daily; glutaraldehyde 10% paint twice daily to warts

## Adverse effects
- Allergic contact dermatitis (formaldehyde is a major allergen), irritation, brown staining (glutaraldehyde), hardening of skin

## Contraindications
- Formaldehyde allergy; broken skin

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid.

## Viva points
- Formaldehyde — common contact allergen (cosmetics, textiles)

_Sources: Khopkar ch.20 and ch.30. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
